scenes.title: Into the Event Horizon
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# EVENT HORIZON
# A camera falls through a continuously warped star field toward a rotating
# black hole. No spatial lattice is used anywhere in the image.

function moving star field at x y with scale phase time:
    execute:
        set depth to fractional part of (time * 0.13 + phase)
        set expansion to 0.42 + ((depth * depth) * 3.6)
        set star_x to (x / expansion) * scale
        set star_y to (y / expansion) * scale
        set points to spark field at star_x star_y (phase * 13.7)
        set streak_x to spark field at (star_x * 0.33) star_y (phase * 13.7 + 0.09)
        set streak_y to spark field at star_x (star_y * 0.33) (phase * 13.7 - 0.11)
        set streaks to (streak_x + streak_y) * glow from 0.0 to 1.35 at (the square root of (x * x + y * y))
        set twinkle to (the sine of (time * 2.7 + phase * 29.0)) * 0.13 + 0.87
        return (((points * 2.8) + (streaks * 0.17)) * (0.28 + (depth * 1.25))) * twinkle

set pixel_x to the fragment x coordinate
set pixel_y to the fragment y coordinate
set time to the shader time
set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
set aspect to width / height
set screen_x to (((pixel_x / width) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect
set screen_y to ((pixel_y / height) * 2.0) - 1.0

# The fall accelerates and drifts, making the horizon consume the camera.
set flight_scale to (0.62 + (time * 0.055)) + ((time * time) * 0.0018)
set drift_x to (the sine of (time * 0.27)) * 0.048
set drift_y to (the cosine of (time * 0.21)) * 0.026
set x to (screen_x + drift_x) / flight_scale
set y to (screen_y + drift_y) / flight_scale
set radius to the square root of (x * x + y * y)
set safe_radius to the maximum of radius and 0.001

# Gravitational lensing twists and magnifies the universe around the shadow.
set lens_angle to 0.19 / (radius * radius + 0.021) + time * 0.035
set lens_angle to the minimum of lens_angle and 4.6
set lens_sine to the sine of lens_angle
set lens_cosine to the cosine of lens_angle
set lens_scale to 1.0 + 0.12 / (radius * radius + 0.012)
set universe_x to (x * lens_cosine - y * lens_sine) * lens_scale
set universe_y to (x * lens_sine + y * lens_cosine) * lens_scale

# A continuous domain-warped nebula replaces the old square value-noise field.
set cloud_one to flowing field at (universe_x * 1.8 + time * 0.025) (universe_y * 1.8 - 4.0) 1.7
set cloud_two to flowing field at (universe_x * 4.6 - 11.0) (universe_y * 4.6 + time * 0.018) 5.3
set cloud_ridge to ridged field at (universe_x * 2.4 + 7.0) (universe_y * 2.4 - 9.0) (time * 0.045)
set aurora_phase to (universe_x * 2.7 - universe_y * 3.6) + cloud_one * 8.0
set aurora to (the sine of aurora_phase) * 0.5 + 0.5
set cloud_light to smooth transition from 0.45 to 0.86 at cloud_one
set dust_light to smooth transition from 0.52 to 0.90 at cloud_two
set red to (0.002 + (cloud_light * 0.022)) + ((cloud_ridge * aurora) * 0.075)
set green to (0.004 + (cloud_light * 0.028)) + ((dust_light * aurora) * 0.052)
set blue to (0.014 + (cloud_light * 0.13)) + ((dust_light * (1.0 - aurora)) * 0.24)

# Three curved depth strata stream past the lens.
set stars_far to moving star field at universe_x universe_y with 13.0 0.09 time
set stars_mid to moving star field at universe_x universe_y with 21.0 0.41 time
set stars_near to moving star field at universe_x universe_y with 31.0 0.77 time
set stars to ((stars_far * 0.46) + (stars_mid * 0.76)) + (stars_near * 1.14)
set star_color to flowing field at (universe_x * 5.1) (universe_y * 5.1) 8.2
set red to red + stars * (0.58 + star_color * 0.62)
set green to green + stars * (0.70 + star_color * 0.31)
set blue to blue + stars * (1.25 - star_color * 0.18)

# A dense, tilted accretion flow. Continuous curl controls every filament.
set tilt to 0.12 + (the sine of (time * 0.17)) * 0.018
set tilt_sine to the sine of tilt
set tilt_cosine to the cosine of tilt
set disk_x to x * tilt_cosine + y * tilt_sine
set disk_y to y * tilt_cosine - x * tilt_sine
set stretched_y to disk_y * 7.2
set disk_radius to the square root of (disk_x * disk_x + stretched_y * stretched_y)
set disk_inner to smooth transition from 0.23 to 0.285 at disk_radius
set disk_outer to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.72 to 1.12 at disk_radius
set disk_mask to disk_inner * disk_outer
set turbulence to signed flow at (disk_x * 8.3 + time * 0.52) (stretched_y * 1.8) 3.1
set fine_turbulence to signed flow at (disk_x * 18.0 - time * 0.91) (stretched_y * 3.7) 7.9
set spiral_phase to (((disk_radius * 39.0) - (time * 6.8)) + (turbulence * 7.4)) + (fine_turbulence * 2.2)
set spiral to (the sine of spiral_phase) * 0.5 + 0.5
set braided_phase to ((disk_radius * 71.0) - (time * 10.4)) - (turbulence * 4.0)
set braided to (the cosine of braided_phase) * 0.5 + 0.5
set hot_inner to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.29 to 0.83 at disk_radius
set disk_energy to (disk_mask * ((0.19 + (spiral * 0.58)) + (braided * 0.23))) * (0.55 + (hot_inner * 4.4))
set approaching to saturate ((disk_x / the maximum of disk_radius and 0.001) * 0.5 + 0.5)
set red to red + disk_energy * (1.72 - approaching * 0.62)
set green to green + disk_energy * (0.30 + approaching * 1.04)
set blue to blue + disk_energy * (0.055 + approaching * 2.18)

# Relativistic jets become visible close to the poles.
set jet_axis to the absolute value of x
set jet_core to glow from 0.0 to 0.032 at jet_axis
set jet_halo to glow from 0.018 to 0.16 at jet_axis
set jet_reach to smooth transition from 0.19 to 0.72 at (the absolute value of y)
set jet_flicker to flowing field at (x * 15.0) (y * 3.0 - time * 0.8) 10.0
set jet to (((jet_core * 0.52) + (jet_halo * 0.13)) * jet_reach) * (0.35 + (jet_flicker * 0.65))
set red to red + jet * 0.21
set green to green + jet * 0.48
set blue to blue + jet * 1.36

# The shadow erases the far universe. The near side of the disk remains.
set horizon to 1.0 - smooth transition from 0.176 to 0.202 at radius
set red to red * (1.0 - horizon)
set green to green * (1.0 - horizon)
set blue to blue * (1.0 - horizon)
set near_side to 1.0 - smooth transition from -0.019 to 0.015 at disk_y
set foreground_disk to disk_energy * near_side
set red to red + foreground_disk * (1.61 - approaching * 0.48)
set green to green + foreground_disk * (0.34 + approaching * 0.93)
set blue to blue + foreground_disk * (0.07 + approaching * 1.94)

# Light wraps around both poles into a sharp photon ring.
set photon_distance to the absolute value of (radius - 0.216)
set photon_ring to glow from 0.001 to 0.017 at photon_distance
set polar_amount to the absolute value of (y / safe_radius)
set polar_arcs to photon_ring * smooth transition from 0.16 to 0.86 at polar_amount
set ring_flicker to (the sine of (time * 2.1 + turbulence * 5.0)) * 0.10 + 0.90
set red to (red + ((photon_ring * 1.34) * ring_flicker)) + (polar_arcs * 2.2)
set green to (green + ((photon_ring * 0.72) * ring_flicker)) + (polar_arcs * 0.93)
set blue to (blue + ((photon_ring * 0.44) * ring_flicker)) + (polar_arcs * 1.48)

# Filmic compression without a raster film: the browser shades every pixel.
set horizon_gap to the absolute value of (radius - 0.202)
set halo to (0.04 / (horizon_gap + 0.04)) * (1.0 - horizon)
set red to red + halo * 0.19
set green to green + halo * 0.07
set blue to blue + halo * 0.31
set vignette_radius to the square root of ((screen_x / aspect) * (screen_x / aspect) + screen_y * screen_y)
set vignette to 0.18 + (1.0 - smooth transition from 0.48 to 1.34 at vignette_radius) * 0.82
set red to the square root of ((red * vignette) / (1.0 + red))
set green to the square root of ((green * vignette) / (1.0 + green))
set blue to the square root of ((blue * vignette) / (1.0 + blue))
set the fragment color to red green blue 1.0

scenes.title: Endless Terrain
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# ENDLESS TERRAIN
# The surface is a procedural height field intersected by every camera ray.
# Elevation therefore changes silhouette, perspective, normals, and light.

function terrain height at x z:
    execute:
        set warp_x to (the sine of (x * 0.083 + z * 0.047)) + (the cosine of (x * -0.031 + z * 0.071)) * 0.53
        set warp_z to (the cosine of (x * -0.057 + z * 0.061)) + (the sine of (x * 0.069 + z * 0.029)) * 0.47
        set bent_x to x + warp_x * 3.4
        set bent_z to z + warp_z * 3.4
        set continental to (the sine of (bent_x * 0.073 + bent_z * 0.051)) * 0.62
        set crossing to (the cosine of (bent_x * -0.049 + bent_z * 0.091)) * 0.34
        set ridge_one to (the cosine of ((bent_x * 0.17 - bent_z * 0.11) + warp_z * 0.31)) * 0.5 + 0.5
        set ridge_two to (the cosine of ((bent_x * -0.13 - bent_z * 0.23) - warp_x * 0.27)) * 0.5 + 0.5
        set ridge_three to (the cosine of ((bent_x * 0.29 + bent_z * 0.07) + warp_z * 0.19)) * 0.5 + 0.5
        set ridge_one to (ridge_one * ridge_one) * (ridge_one * ridge_one)
        set ridge_two to (ridge_two * ridge_two) * (ridge_two * ridge_two)
        set ridge_three to (ridge_three * ridge_three) * (ridge_three * ridge_three)
        set alpine_peaks to ((ridge_one * 2.08) + (ridge_two * 1.46)) + (ridge_three * 0.92)
        set mountain_mask to smooth transition from -0.46 to 0.54 at (continental + crossing)
        set peak_height to alpine_peaks * (0.31 + mountain_mask * 0.78)
        set detail_one to (the sine of (bent_x * 0.51 + bent_z * 0.37)) * 0.10
        set detail_two to (the cosine of (bent_x * -0.83 + bent_z * 0.61)) * 0.045
        return (((((-0.31 + continental) + (crossing * 0.54)) + peak_height) + detail_one) + detail_two)

set pixel_x to the fragment x coordinate
set pixel_y to the fragment y coordinate
set time to the shader time
set width to the maximum of the shader width and 1.0
set height to the maximum of the shader height and 1.0
set aspect to width / height
set screen_x to (((pixel_x / width) * 2.0) - 1.0) * aspect
set screen_y to ((pixel_y / height) * 2.0) - 1.0

# The camera glides above intersecting ranges instead of following a valley.
set camera_x to ((the sine of (time * 0.13)) * 3.1) + (the cosine of (time * 0.071)) * 1.4
set camera_y to 3.26 + (the sine of (time * 0.19)) * 0.13
set camera_z to 76.0 + time * 3.05
set yaw to ((the sine of (time * 0.097)) * 0.16) + (the cosine of (time * 0.061)) * 0.07
set yaw_sine to the sine of yaw
set yaw_cosine to the cosine of yaw
set bank to (the sine of (time * 0.19)) * 0.025
set bank_sine to the sine of bank
set bank_cosine to the cosine of bank
set view_x to screen_x * bank_cosine - screen_y * bank_sine
set view_y to screen_x * bank_sine + screen_y * bank_cosine
set raw_direction_x to view_x * 0.68
set raw_direction_y to view_y * 0.68 - 0.19
set raw_direction_z to 1.24
set direction_x to raw_direction_x * yaw_cosine + raw_direction_z * yaw_sine
set direction_z to raw_direction_z * yaw_cosine - raw_direction_x * yaw_sine
set direction_length to the square root of (((direction_x * direction_x) + (raw_direction_y * raw_direction_y)) + (direction_z * direction_z))
set direction_x to direction_x / direction_length
set direction_y to raw_direction_y / direction_length
set direction_z to direction_z / direction_length

# Dawn sky and curved clouds are evaluated independently from the terrain.
set sky_height to saturate (screen_y * 0.54 + 0.45)
set red to 0.018 + sky_height * 0.075
set green to 0.052 + sky_height * 0.16
set blue to 0.12 + sky_height * 0.34
set cloud_broad to flowing field at (screen_x * 1.25 + time * 0.018) (screen_y * 2.4 + 3.0) 2.1
set cloud_ridges to ridged field at (screen_x * 2.1 - 8.0) (screen_y * 3.7 + time * 0.012) 5.7
set cloud_shape to smooth transition from 0.54 to 0.82 at (cloud_broad * 0.76 + cloud_ridges * 0.24)
set cloud_altitude to smooth transition from -0.05 to 0.31 at screen_y
set cloud_light to cloud_shape * cloud_altitude
set red to red + cloud_light * 0.34
set green to green + cloud_light * 0.31
set blue to blue + cloud_light * 0.27
set sun_x to screen_x - 0.56
set sun_y to screen_y - 0.39
set sun_distance to the square root of (sun_x * sun_x + sun_y * sun_y)
set sun_core to glow from 0.018 to 0.075 at sun_distance
set sun_halo to glow from 0.06 to 0.42 at sun_distance
set red to (red + (sun_halo * 0.27)) + (sun_core * 1.3)
set green to (green + (sun_halo * 0.16)) + (sun_core * 0.92)
set blue to (blue + (sun_halo * 0.08)) + (sun_core * 0.52)

# Uniform height-field traversal covers the complete view depth for every ray.
# The previous and current samples bracket the first surface crossing, then six
# refinements recover a stable sharp surface.
set terrain_hit to false
set travel to 0.12
set previous_travel to travel
set hit_distance to travel
set sample_x to camera_x
set sample_y to camera_y
set sample_z to camera_z
set surface_height to terrain height at sample_x sample_z
set march_step to 0
while march_step < 96 and not terrain_hit:
    set sample_x to camera_x + direction_x * travel
    set sample_y to camera_y + direction_y * travel
    set sample_z to camera_z + direction_z * travel
    set surface_height to terrain height at sample_x sample_z
    if sample_y < surface_height:
        set terrain_hit to true
        set hit_distance to travel
    else:
        set previous_travel to travel
        set travel to travel + 0.46
        if travel > 44.0:
            set march_step to 96
    set march_step to march_step + 1

set refinement to 0
while refinement < 6 and terrain_hit:
    set middle_travel to (previous_travel + hit_distance) * 0.5
    set middle_x to camera_x + direction_x * middle_travel
    set middle_y to camera_y + direction_y * middle_travel
    set middle_z to camera_z + direction_z * middle_travel
    set middle_height to terrain height at middle_x middle_z
    if middle_y < middle_height:
        set hit_distance to middle_travel
    else:
        set previous_travel to middle_travel
    set refinement to refinement + 1

if terrain_hit:
    set world_x to camera_x + direction_x * hit_distance
    set world_y to camera_y + direction_y * hit_distance
    set world_z to camera_z + direction_z * hit_distance
    set surface_height to terrain height at world_x world_z

    # Finite differences turn real elevation into real surface light.
    set normal_step to 0.055 + hit_distance * 0.0018
    set height_left to terrain height at (world_x - normal_step) world_z
    set height_right to terrain height at (world_x + normal_step) world_z
    set height_back to terrain height at world_x (world_z - normal_step)
    set height_front to terrain height at world_x (world_z + normal_step)
    set normal_x to height_left - height_right
    set normal_y to normal_step * 2.0
    set normal_z to height_back - height_front
    set normal_length to the square root of (((normal_x * normal_x) + (normal_y * normal_y)) + (normal_z * normal_z))
    set normal_x to normal_x / normal_length
    set normal_y to normal_y / normal_length
    set normal_z to normal_z / normal_length

    set sunlight to saturate (((normal_x * 0.48) + (normal_y * 0.76)) - (normal_z * 0.44))
    set sky_fill to saturate (normal_y * 0.5 + 0.5)
    set material to flowing field at (world_x * 0.72) (world_z * 0.72) 9.4
    set ground_detail to ridged field at (world_x * 1.91 + 4.0) (world_z * 1.91 - 7.0) 3.8
    set mineral_detail to flowing field at (world_x * 3.4 - 9.0) (world_z * 3.4 + 2.0) 6.1
    set exposed_rock to smooth transition from 0.16 to 0.61 at (1.0 - normal_y)
    set snow to smooth transition from 1.48 to 2.28 at surface_height
    set ground_red to (0.018 + material * 0.047) + ground_detail * 0.021
    set ground_green to (0.075 + material * 0.15) + ground_detail * 0.052
    set ground_blue to (0.052 + material * 0.083) + ground_detail * 0.039
    set rock_red to (0.115 + material * 0.11) + mineral_detail * 0.087
    set rock_green to (0.098 + material * 0.075) + mineral_detail * 0.061
    set rock_blue to (0.105 + material * 0.095) + mineral_detail * 0.073
    set ground_red to ground_red * (1.0 - exposed_rock) + rock_red * exposed_rock
    set ground_green to ground_green * (1.0 - exposed_rock) + rock_green * exposed_rock
    set ground_blue to ground_blue * (1.0 - exposed_rock) + rock_blue * exposed_rock
    set ground_red to ground_red * (1.0 - snow) + 0.78 * snow
    set ground_green to ground_green * (1.0 - snow) + 0.84 * snow
    set ground_blue to ground_blue * (1.0 - snow) + 0.89 * snow
    set lighting to (0.11 + (sunlight * 1.13)) + (sky_fill * 0.16)
    set ground_red to ground_red * lighting + sunlight * 0.24
    set ground_green to ground_green * lighting + sunlight * 0.17
    set ground_blue to ground_blue * lighting + sunlight * 0.09

    # Atmospheric perspective reveals depth without drawing a path or band.
    set fog to smooth transition from 11.0 to 41.0 at hit_distance
    set fog_red to 0.19 + sun_halo * 0.16
    set fog_green to 0.25 + sun_halo * 0.10
    set fog_blue to 0.31 + sun_halo * 0.05
    set red to ground_red * (1.0 - fog) + fog_red * fog
    set green to ground_green * (1.0 - fog) + fog_green * fog
    set blue to ground_blue * (1.0 - fog) + fog_blue * fog

set vignette_radius to the square root of ((screen_x / aspect) * (screen_x / aspect) + screen_y * screen_y)
set vignette to 0.34 + (1.0 - smooth transition from 0.57 to 1.33 at vignette_radius) * 0.66
set red to the square root of ((red * vignette) / (1.0 + red * 0.42))
set green to the square root of ((green * vignette) / (1.0 + green * 0.42))
set blue to the square root of ((blue * vignette) / (1.0 + blue * 0.42))
set the fragment color to red green blue 1.0

scenes.title: Nano Choreography
scenes.source:
import lib/shader_art.dl

# NANO CHOREOGRAPHY
# A raymarched crystal and motorcycle give way to a model-derived volumetric
# Vitruvian point cloud. Both passes are compiled from this DynLex source.

function scene window from opening to closing at moment:
    execute:
        set arrival to smooth transition from opening to (opening + 0.55) at moment
        set departure to 1.0 - smooth transition from (closing - 0.55) to closing at moment
        return arrival * departure

function crystal distance at x y z with yaw pitch:
    execute:
        set yaw_sine to the sine of yaw
        set yaw_cosine to the cosine of yaw
        set turned_x to x * yaw_cosine + z * yaw_sine
        set turned_z to z * yaw_cosine - x * yaw_sine
        set pitch_sine to the sine of pitch
        set pitch_cosine to the cosine of pitch
        set turned_y to y * pitch_cosine - turned_z * pitch_sine
        set turned_z to turned_z * pitch_cosine + y * pitch_sine
        set octahedron to ((((the absolute value of turned_x) + (the absolute value of turned_y)) + (the absolute value of turned_z)) - 1.08) * 0.577
        set cut_core to ellipsoid distance at turned_x turned_y turned_z with radii 0.82 1.14 0.82
        return the maximum of octahedron and cut_core

function motorcycle distance at x y z with progress wheel_spin motorcycle_yaw:
    execute:
        # Translation through depth makes the motorcycle race toward the lens.
        set center_x to (0.0 - 1.26) + (progress * 1.18)
        set center_y to (0.0 - 0.19) + (progress * 0.12)
        set center_z to 2.80 - progress * 4.90
        set translated_x to x - center_x
        set translated_y to y - center_y
        set translated_z to z - center_z
        set yaw_sine to the sine of motorcycle_yaw
        set yaw_cosine to the cosine of motorcycle_yaw
        set local_x to translated_x * yaw_cosine + translated_z * yaw_sine
        set local_y to translated_y
        set local_z to translated_z * yaw_cosine - translated_x * yaw_sine

        # Deep tires, hubs, and rotating crossed spokes establish real volume.
        set wheel_depth to 0.13
        set rear_x to local_x + 0.72
        set front_x to local_x - 0.72
        set wheel_y to local_y + 0.42
        set rear_wheel to torus distance at rear_x wheel_y local_z with major radius 0.30 and tube radius 0.055
        set front_wheel to torus distance at front_x wheel_y local_z with major radius 0.30 and tube radius 0.055
        set model_distance to the minimum of rear_wheel and front_wheel
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (ellipsoid distance at rear_x wheel_y local_z with radii 0.095 0.095 wheel_depth)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (ellipsoid distance at front_x wheel_y local_z with radii 0.095 0.095 wheel_depth)

        set spoke_cosine to the cosine of wheel_spin
        set spoke_sine to the sine of wheel_spin
        set rear_spoke_x to spoke_cosine * 0.265
        set rear_spoke_y to spoke_sine * 0.265
        set front_spoke_x to spoke_sine * 0.265
        set front_spoke_y to spoke_cosine * 0.265
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point rear_x wheel_y local_z to capsule (0.0 - rear_spoke_x) (0.0 - rear_spoke_y) 0.0 rear_spoke_x rear_spoke_y 0.0 with 0.018)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point rear_x wheel_y local_z to capsule (0.0 - rear_spoke_y) rear_spoke_x 0.0 rear_spoke_y (0.0 - rear_spoke_x) 0.0 with 0.018)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point front_x wheel_y local_z to capsule (0.0 - front_spoke_x) (0.0 - front_spoke_y) 0.0 front_spoke_x front_spoke_y 0.0 with 0.018)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point front_x wheel_y local_z to capsule (0.0 - front_spoke_y) front_spoke_x 0.0 front_spoke_y (0.0 - front_spoke_x) 0.0 with 0.018)

        # Twin-cradle frame, fork, tank, engine, saddle, and handlebars.
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point local_x local_y local_z to capsule -0.72 -0.42 0.0 -0.18 0.08 0.0 with 0.045)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point local_x local_y local_z to capsule -0.18 0.08 0.0 0.72 -0.42 0.0 with 0.045)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point local_x local_y local_z to capsule 0.72 -0.42 0.0 -0.34 -0.42 0.0 with 0.045)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point local_x local_y local_z to capsule -0.34 -0.42 0.0 -0.18 0.08 0.0 with 0.045)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point local_x local_y local_z to capsule 0.55 -0.28 -0.07 0.77 0.28 -0.07 with 0.032)
        set model_distance to the minimum of model_distance and (distance from three dimensional point local_x local_y local_z to capsule 0.55 -0.28 0.07 0.77 0.28 0.07 with 0.032)
